market_reason: Oil near $100-105 with Iran escalating Hormuz attacks, Indonesia's worst selloff since 1998, and AI-led tech weakness (Nasdaq-100 down ~3.5% on the week) are elevated risks, but the broader market is holding up.
market_headlines: U.S. crude oil tops $100 as Iran escalates Hormuz attacks, Ukraine vows to hit Russian refineries - CNBC
Oil Prices Are Stuck at $105 as Geopolitical Risks Mount - Yahoo Finance
Indonesian stocks sink most since 1998 on MSCI downgrade warning - Reuters
summary: Oil is above $100 as Iran escalates Hormuz attacks. Tech and AI names are under pressure, with the Nasdaq-100 down about 3.5% on the week, and Fed Chair Warsh gave no new rate signals. None of this is a fresh, crisis-grade shock that justifies a higher level or a veto.
